items.name: Sandpile-Fractal-Dimension
items.description: Code behind undergraduate research project. Models abelian sandpiles on hexagonal, square, and triangular lattices with the main goal to calculate the fractal dimension of sandpile avalanches.

items.name: sandpile-model-project
items.description: Simulation and analysis of the Abelian Sandpile Model using Python in Google Colab. This project demonstrates self-organized criticality, avalanche dynamics, and grid-based sandpile evolution through computational physics simulations.

items.name: Sandpile-model-Project
items.description: Self-organized criticality simulation using the sandpile model. SAS/IML implementation analyzing avalanche sizes, power-law distributions and 1/f noise via log-log regression. Illustrates how complex systems generate scale-free dynamics similar to financial market fluctuations.

items.name: distillation-column-avalanche-model
items.description: Python simulation of a multi-tray distillation column modeled as a self-organized criticality (SOC) system using a sandpile-inspired avalanche dynamics framework to study flooding cascades, power-law behavior, and connectivity effects.

items.name: Emergent-Dynamical-Ising-Transition-in-Diffusive-Sandpiles
items.description: Code accompanying “Emergent Dynamical Ising Transition in Diffusive Sandpiles”. Includes simulations of diffusive sandpiles, MSS cluster analysis, avalanche statistics, inverse Ising reconstruction, and identification of a magnetic instability linked to a correlated percolation transition.

items.name: Paper-Sovereign-Stress-Avalanche
items.description: Replication package for an empirical SOC analysis of monthly J.P. Morgan EMBI Global Diversified spreads (11 LATAM economies, 2007–2026), with avalanche dynamics, network geometry (Forman/Ollivier-Ricci, spectral fragility), and a 1,000-replicate reshuffling placebo. Sandpile Economics Program.

items.name: THE-AVALANCHE-WAS-ALWAYS-THE-CRYSTAL
items.description: In the late 1980s, the physicist Per Bak built a virtual sandpile: a grid of cells where grains dropped at random and toppled when any cell exceeded a critical height, sending grains to neighbors, triggering chains of further topplings. What emerged was self-organized criticality

items.name: Self-Organized-Criticality-Sandplie
items.description: By modeling the SOC theory using a sandpile model, we presented four simulation scenarios, all of which demonstrated power-law distributions of avalanches.

items.name: MarkovMPS
items.description: Classical stochastic dynamics as tensor networks: this package computes first-passage statistics and Manna sandpile avalanche-size distributions from continuous-time Markov generators written as tensor trains, cross-checked against an exact engine, Monte Carlo, and closed forms. Available as independent Julia and Python pipelines.

items.name: sand
items.description: 同步水填充沙堆元胞自动机：按局部高差触发崩塌，完全同步松弛，支持均匀、手动与正态分布落沙，用于研究雪崩动力学。Deterministic sandpile cellular automaton with slope-triggered water-filling relaxation, fully synchronous updates, open boundaries, and pluggable drop modes for avalanche dynamics.
